purpose: Verify the full-width crest road on both springs and the cooling tower on the single-cover plate.
projection: Transform each outer-wall line from plate coordinates to the installed wing profile. Report the highest path centerline plus half the outer-wall width. The straight length is measured at that height on each wing.
tower_timing_scope: Sum line lengths divided by command feed while depositing tower material. Travel, shutter and acceleration add time away from the part.
